explication: Matcha is a terminal email client. The main workflow starts at the CLI, launches the Bubble Tea application, fetches mail for configured accounts, and presents inbox and message views; users can then search, act on messages, or compose and send mail. A daemon-backed service mediates mailbox operations, with direct-provider fallback. Other documented or indexed capabilities include plugins and their marketplace, rich email rendering, export, encryption, and the optional macOS menu-bar helper. Some subsystem links are omitted where sampled sources do not show their runtime wiring.
